paper.title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning
paper.abstract: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation f

summary.core_problem: 对齐后的LLM在不同系统提示人设下对同一请求会做出不同的安全决策，即人设诱导的安全行为变异问题。
summary.importance: 问题发现+方法创新：首次系统定义并测量人设诱导的安全变异现象，提出人设不变的安全微调方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出两个拒绝率指标（人设诱导偏差TID和人设诱导翻转率TIFR）衡量安全变异；通过表示分析发现人设在低维子空间扰动安全表示；提出TIST（人设不变安全微调）方法。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中给出具体模型规模、基线和量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Aligned LLMs can make different safety decisions for the same request when different persona traits are assigned in the system prompt—a failure mode called trait-induced safety variation.
summary_en.importance: Problem identification + methodological contribution: first systematic measurement of trait-induced safety variation, with a representation-level analysis and a mitigation method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces refusal-based metrics (Trait-Induced Deviation and Trait-Induced Flip Rate); finds via representation analysis that traits perturb safety representations in a low-dimensional subspace; proposes Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning (TIST).
summary_en.experiments: Specific model sizes, baselines, and quantitative improvement magnitudes are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 安全对齐的细分问题，人设影响安全决策这一现象对理解系统提示与对齐的交互有启发，但方法本身是常规微调改进，看摘要和表示分析部分即可。
recommendation.en: A niche safety alignment problem; the finding that system-prompt traits perturb safety representations is interesting for understanding prompt-alignment interactions, but the method is a standard tuning variant—skim the representation analysis.

paper.title: Separating Decision-Rule Misalignment from Readout-Coverage Limitations in Speech Language Models
paper.abstract: Speech language models are increasingly evaluated on paralinguistic tasks by the accuracy of prompted answers, but answer accuracy combines failures at different stages of the audio-to-answer computation. We introduce a generation-aligned diagnostic ladder that compares the emitted answer, the option logits, an affine readout of those logits, and a linear readout of the hidden state at the same answer token. Successive differences separate endpoint, decision-rule, and readout-coverage gaps. Acro

summary.core_problem: 解决 speech language model 在副语言任务上“生成答案准确率”混合了表示、读出和决策规则多种失败来源的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于机制诊断和评测方法改进。它提醒音频 LM 的能力评估不能只看 prompt answer accuracy，因为隐藏状态里可能已有信息，但模型原生读出头或决策规则没有正确使用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 generation-aligned diagnostic ladder，在同一个 answer token 位置比较四层信号：实际生成答案、选项 logits、对 logits 的 affine readout、对 hidden state 的 linear readout。相邻层级差异被解释为 endpoint gap、decision-rule gap 和 readout-coverage gap。还测试 label-free logit correction，看决策规则缺陷是否可直接修正。
summary.experiments: 在 5 个 speech language model 和 2 个情绪语料上评估。hidden-state decoding 平均比实际生成高 27.8 个准确率点；10 个条件下 decision-rule gap 和 readout-coverage gap 都为正。label-free logit correction 在所有条件下提升生成准确率。摘要还声称 hidden state 中未被原生读出使用的情绪信息能泛化到 held-out speakers，并经过声学描述符控制。
summary.authors_note: 给定机构信息较混乱，只能确认作者信息中出现 University of Texas at Austin。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper separates different failure sources behind prompted answer accuracy in speech language models on paralinguistic tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a diagnostic and mechanism-analysis contribution. It is relevant because audio LM evaluation can underestimate internal representations when the native readout or decision rule fails to use information already present in hidden states.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a generation-aligned diagnostic ladder comparing, at the same answer-token position, the emitted answer, option logits, an affine readout of those logits, and a linear readout of the hidden state. Differences between adjacent levels are used to estimate endpoint, decision-rule, and readout-coverage gaps. A label-free logit correction tests whether part of the decision-rule gap is actionable.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover five speech language models and two emotion corpora. Hidden-state decoding exceeds generation by 27.8 accuracy points on average. Both decision-rule and readout-coverage gaps are positive in all ten model-corpus conditions. A label-free logit correction improves generated accuracy in every condition, and the extra hidden-state emotion information generalizes to held-out speakers under acoustic-control checks.
summary_en.authors_note: The institution metadata is noisy; the supplied information indicates a connection to the University of Texas at Austin.

recommendation.zh: 音频 LM 方向可看 diagnostic ladder；27.8 点 readout gap 是好信号，但别把它误读成生成能力提升。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance for audio LM diagnostics; the 27.8-point readout gap is useful, but do not confuse it with improved generative competence.

paper.title: Reasoning Errors Have a Region and a Direction in the Residual-Stream Trajectory of LLMs
paper.abstract: As language models are increasingly used for tasks that require verifiable reasoning, reliably distinguishing sound reasoning from flawed reasoning has become an important practical problem. Recent trajectory-based methods seek this signal in layerwise residual-stream displacements, which capture how representations change while attenuating some stable, token-specific information. However, displacement omits the state from which an update originates, whereas restoring the full state risks reintr

summary.core_problem: 现有基于残差流层间位移的推理正确性探测方法，存在位移丢初始状态、全状态探测易引入捷径特征的权衡，无法可靠区分正确与错误推理。
summary.importance: 方法类增量改进，通过拆分状态表示的粒度平衡探测精度与捷径风险，为推理过程的内部表示探测提供了新的设计思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三流检测器：一路捕捉层间运动信息，一路基于向量量化做粗粒度区域位置读取，一路在归一化多层状态上做细粒度方向读取，仅保留受限的位置上下文避免捷径。
summary.experiments: 在训练阶段未见过的推理基准上，相比纯位移探测方法，正确推理结果的选择准确率最高提升12%。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing residual-stream displacement based reasoning correctness probes face a trade-off: displacement omits initial state context, while full-state probing reintroduces shortcut-prone features.
summary_en.importance: An incremental method design that balances probing accuracy and shortcut risk by disentangling state representation granularity, offering a new design reference for internal reasoning representation probing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a three-stream detector: one stream captures inter-layer motion, one uses vector quantization for coarse region reading, one performs fine-grained direction reading over normalized multi-layer states, retaining only restricted location context to avoid shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: On reasoning benchmarks unseen during training, the method improves correct reasoning selection accuracy by up to 12% compared to displacement-only baselines.

recommendation.zh: 残差流探测推理错误的增量改进，三流拆分位置与运动的设计有参考性，无训练侧可直接落地的结论
recommendation.en: Incremental work on residual-stream reasoning error detection, the three-stream design is decent but offers no actionable insights for pretraining.

institutions: Australian Institute for Machine Learning, University of Adelaide

paper.title: IRIS: A Visual Cortex-Inspired Framework for Analyzing Orientation Selectivity in Vision Transformers
paper.abstract: Vision transformers (ViTs) have become the de facto standard for image encoding across many perception tasks. Despite their empirical success, it remains mechanistically unclear how they encode low-level features, given their lack of inductive biases: ViTs process information globally rather than relying on local structure. Biological visual systems, in contrast, build low-level features, such as orientation selectivity in the primary visual cortex, by combining information from small, localized

summary.core_problem: 分析 ViT 是否以及如何形成类似生物视觉皮层的低级方向选择性表示。
summary.importance: 这是视觉表示机制分析论文，贡献是提出一组受神经科学启发的指标来测量 ViT 中 orientation selectivity 的出现方式；对 VLM 视觉编码器选择和解释有弱相关性，但不直接改变 LLM 预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: IRIS 框架引入 representational similarity score、orientation recruitment score 等指标，用于检测 ViT 表示是否按方向刺激形成结构化响应，并分析这种低级特征在不同层或模块中的出现位置。方法是把神经科学测量思路迁移到 ViT 表征分析中。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体模型清单、训练数据或数值结果；可以确认的是论文针对 ViT 图像编码器做系统测量，而不是提出新的训练目标或架构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes whether and how Vision Transformers develop low-level orientation-selective representations analogous to those observed in the biological visual cortex.
summary_en.importance: This is a representation-mechanism study for visual encoders. Its main contribution is a neuroscience-inspired measurement suite for orientation selectivity in ViTs. It has weak relevance to VLM visual encoder analysis, but it does not change LLM pretraining practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: IRIS introduces metrics such as representational similarity score and orientation recruitment score to test whether ViT representations show structured responses to oriented stimuli and where such low-level features arise across the model. The approach transfers neuroscience-style probes to ViT representation analysis.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not list the exact model set, training data, or quantitative findings. It indicates a systematic analysis of ViT image encoders rather than a new objective, architecture, or pretraining recipe.

recommendation.zh: 若关心 VLM 视觉编码器机制，可看指标定义；对语言预训练没有动作项，别在实验细节上花时间。
recommendation.en: Useful only if you care about visual-encoder mechanisms for VLMs; read the metric definitions, not the full experimental detail.

paper.title: DiverseDiT++: Quantifying, Analyzing, and Promoting Representation Diversity in Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have enabled remarkable progress in visual synthesis, benefiting from their superior scalability. To facilitate DiTs' capability of capturing meaningful internal representations, recent works such as REPA incorporate external pretrained encoders for representation alignment. However, the underlying mechanisms governing representation learning within DiTs remain poorly understood in the community. To this end, this paper first presents a systematic

summary.core_problem: 分析 Diffusion Transformer 内部各层表征是否足够多样，以及这种多样性如何影响视觉生成中的表征学习。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析加轻量方法改进。它不直接研究语言模型预训练，但对理解 DiT 训练动态、外部表征对齐和层间功能分化有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Weighted Diversity Score，用于量化 DiT 不同 block 表征之间的差异；随后在多种训练和对齐设置下分析表征多样性的演化，并尝试通过促进 block-wise diversity 改善表征学习。方法上更像对 REPA 类外部 encoder 对齐工作的诊断和补充。
summary.experiments: 摘要称进行了系统实验，覆盖不同设置下 DiT 内部表征演化与影响分析，并验证提升表征多样性可改善 DiT 表征学习；给定信息未包含模型规模、数据集、FID 或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether internal representations in Diffusion Transformers are sufficiently diverse across blocks, and how that diversity affects representation learning for visual synthesis.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a representation-analysis metric plus a diversity-promoting intervention. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it is useful for researchers tracking DiT training dynamics and representation alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce Weighted Diversity Score to measure discrepancies among block-wise representations, then analyze how representation diversity evolves under different training and alignment settings. The work is positioned as a diagnostic and complement to REPA-style external encoder alignment.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract describes extensive investigations across multiple settings and reports that block-wise diversity is important for effective representation learning in DiTs. The provided excerpt does not include model size, dataset details, FID numbers, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 WDS 定义和多样性消融即可；它给 DiT 内部层分工一个可测信号，但离 LLM pretrain 还隔一层。
recommendation.en: Read the WDS definition and diversity ablations only; it gives a measurable signal for DiT layer specialization, but it is one step removed from LLM pretraining.

paper.title: Predicting Multilingual Classification and Translation Performance of LLMs with Cross-Lingual Alignment $\unicode{x2013}$ Is English Enough?
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) have been shown to perform better on non-English classification tasks when the representations of the given language are more aligned to English within the model. Several cross-lingual alignment (CLA) scores have been proposed for use with LLMs, along with multiple approaches for extracting embeddings from the models. We provide a comparative analysis of 27 CLA score variants, examining how they differ and how well each predicts downstream performance ac

summary.core_problem: 分析 cross-lingual alignment 分数能否预测 LLM 在多语言分类和机器翻译上的表现，尤其检验“与英语对齐是否足够”。
summary.importance: 贡献是多语言表示分析。它系统比较 27 种 CLA score variant，并把以往主要用于分类任务的表示对齐指标扩展到生成式翻译任务；对多语言预训练的数据配比、表示对齐和评测代理指标有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 比较不同 CLA 分数和不同 embedding 抽取方式，研究它们与三类下游任务表现的相关性。为能跨目标语言计算翻译质量相关性，提出 PMI-based translation metric，降低对目标语言本身的依赖，并报告其与 chrF 强相关。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 27 种 CLA score variant 和三项任务，包括分类与机器翻译。摘要指出 PMI-based translation metric 与 chrF 强相关，并发现与英语的 CLA 可预测翻译表现；具体语言集合、模型列表、相关系数和最佳 CLA 变体需要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Charles University、Technical University of Munich 和 Munich Center for Machine Learning。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes whether cross-lingual alignment scores can predict multilingual classification and translation performance in LLMs, with a focus on whether English alignment is enough.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a multilingual representation analysis. It compares 27 CLA score variants and extends an alignment-based diagnostic, previously used mostly for classification, to generative machine translation. This is relevant to multilingual pretraining mixtures, representation alignment, and proxy evaluation metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare multiple CLA scores and embedding extraction choices, then measure how well they correlate with performance across three tasks. To compute correlations across target languages for translation, they propose a PMI-based translation metric that is less target-language dependent and strongly correlated with chrF.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 27 CLA score variants and three tasks spanning classification and translation. The abstract reports that the PMI-based translation metric correlates strongly with chrF and that English-based CLA predicts translation performance. The exact language set, model list, correlation values, and best-performing CLA variants require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Charles University, Technical University of Munich, and the Munich Center for Machine Learning.

recommendation.zh: 多语言 pretrain 可看相关性表；若只给 English alignment 代理指标，别直接当训练目标。
recommendation.en: For multilingual pretraining, check the correlation tables; do not turn English alignment into a training objective without stronger evidence.

paper.title: Where did the ambiguity go? Examining how multimodal models interpret polysemous words
paper.abstract: Human language is highly polysemous. Many common words (e.g., 'bank' or 'palm') carry several distinct meanings that shape what humans communicate and imagine. Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to understand this multiplicity of meaning, but much less is known about how polysemy surfaces in other modalities such as images. We study this across 17 text-to-image and 15 text-generation models by giving each a polysemous word with no context to fix its meaning and measuring which senses a

summary.core_problem: 多模态模型在处理无上下文的多义词时，文本生成与图像生成模态对词义的选择多样性存在系统性差异，且二者的义项分布与人类想象的分布差距尚未被量化，该工作对这一跨模态差距及成因进行测量分析。
summary.importance: 为多模态预训练的表示对齐研究提供了实证观测依据，揭示了多模态模型对歧义的「认知」与「生成」存在脱节，也为后续多模态预训练的词义消歧、输出分布多样性优化提供了可参考的评测范式。
summary.technical_approach: 构建100个经过人类验证的多义词测试集，每个词对应固定的候选义项集合；对17个文生图模型、15个文本生成模型，每个词采样30次独立输出，采用GPT-5.4作为裁判将输出归类到对应义项（或模糊/多义等兜底标签），计算义项分布的归一化熵等指标，并与匹配场景下收集的人类基线对比；额外做了架构类型（扩散vs自回归）、偏好调优前后的消融，以及模型自身对人类义项分布的预测能力测试。
summary.experiments: 观测到明确的跨模态差距：同模型家族内，生成图像的义项归一化熵仅为0.10，生成文本的为0.25，二者均远低于人类的多样性水平；模型被要求预测人类的义项分布时，能输出接近人类的多样性结果，远高于自身实际生成的多样性；偏好调优会进一步收窄义项分布，但对齐并非全部差距的来源；扩散架构与自回归架构的多样性表现存在差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction的问题提出与核心结论，Methodology的测试集构建与评测流程，Results的跨模态差距核心数据；附录的多义词列表可作为评测资源参考。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal models show systematic differences in sense selection diversity across text and image generation when processing polysemous words without disambiguating context, and the gap between their sense distributions and human imagined priors remains unquantified. This work measures this cross-modal gap and analyzes its drivers.
summary_en.importance: It provides empirical observations for multimodal pretraining representation alignment research, exposing a disconnect between what multimodal models know about lexical ambiguity and what they produce during generation. It also offers a reusable evaluation paradigm for future work on polysemy-aware multimodal pretraining and output diversity optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct a test set of 100 human-verified polysemous words, each associated with a closed inventory of candidate senses. They sample 30 independent outputs per word-model pair across 17 text-to-image models and 15 text generation models, use GPT-5.4 as a judge to assign each output to a sense (or fallback labels for unclear/multiple cases), and compute metrics including normalized entropy of sense distributions against a human baseline collected under matched framing. Additional ablations compare behavior across architecture classes (diffusion vs autoregressive) and before/after preference tuning, plus a separate test of models' own predictions of human sense distributions.
summary_en.experiments: A clear cross-modal gap is observed: within the same model family, generated images have a normalized sense entropy of 0.10, versus 0.25 for generated text, both far below human diversity levels. When asked to predict human sense distributions, models produce near-human diversity scores much higher than their own generation output. Preference tuning further narrows sense distributions, but alignment does not account for the full gap. Diffusion and autoregressive architectures show distinct diversity patterns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction for core motivation and headline findings, the Methodology section for test set construction and evaluation protocol, and the Results section for cross-modal gap metrics. The appendix with the full polysemous word list is a useful evaluation resource. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多模态语义坍缩的定量证据干净，0.10 vs 0.25 vs 0.47 的熵对比值得看；对理解 VLM 对齐和表示坍缩有直接参考。
recommendation.en: Clean quantitative evidence of multimodal semantic collapse; the 0.10 vs 0.25 vs 0.47 entropy comparison is worth reading for VLM alignment and representation collapse insights.

paper.title: Training-Free versus Training-Based Intent Classification in LLMs: Accuracy, Robustness, and Failure Modes
paper.abstract: Intent classification in Large Language Models (LLMs) involves categorizing user prompts into predefined classes. For instance, given a user prompt, the system must determine whether it primarily concerns mathematics, coding, or general text processing. Such classification enables routing prompts to specialized models optimized for specific domains, improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. In this work, we conduct a systematic study comparing training-free vs training-based approach

summary.core_problem: 比较 LLM prompt intent classification 中 training-free 方法和 training-based classifier 的准确性、鲁棒性与失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经验分析。问题和模型路由、specialist model dispatch、低成本 serving 有关，但论文核心不是预训练方法，也不是通用 routing 架构突破。
summary.technical_approach: 研究两类 lightweight training-free 方法，基于模型内部表示的统计量进行分类；并与 MLP classifier 和 linear probe 等 training-based 方法比较。关注 easy benchmarks 与 harder fine-grained intent classification 之间的性能差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告三点结论：数学/代码/自然语言这类粗粒度任务上，两类方法都接近饱和；Java vs Python 等更细粒度任务上，training-based classifier 更有优势；training-free 方法存在特定鲁棒性和失败模式。摘要未给出模型规模、数据量或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper compares training-free and training-based intent classifiers for routing LLM prompts across predefined categories.
summary_en.importance: It is an empirical analysis relevant to prompt routing and specialist-model dispatch. The work is adjacent to serving efficiency, but it is not a pretraining method or a new general routing architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: It evaluates two lightweight training-free methods based on statistics of internal representations, and compares them with MLP classifiers and linear probes. The analysis separates easy coarse-grained intent tasks from harder fine-grained tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that both training-free and training-based methods saturate easy benchmarks such as math vs coding vs natural language; training-based classifiers perform better on harder distinctions such as Java vs Python; and training-free methods show specific robustness limits and failure modes. No model sizes, dataset sizes, or exact gains are provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 prompt router 经验备查即可；只看 hard-classification 失败模式，别外推到训练期路由。
recommendation.en: Useful as prompt-router folklore; read the hard-classification failure modes, but do not extrapolate to training-time routing.

paper.title: Tool Specifications Matter: Uncovering and Mitigating Safety Risks in AI Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents extend large language models (LLMs) with external tools, enabling them to perform complex tasks and translate model outputs into consequential real-world actions. Yet LLMs often become substantially less safe when deployed as agents, and the source of this degradation remains poorly understood. In this paper, we identify schema-formatted tool specifications as a primary source of agent safety degradation and show, through white-box representation analysis, that they weaken the model's

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的问题很集中：为什么同一个已经做过安全对齐的 LLM，在普通聊天场景会拒绝有害请求，但一旦接上工具、变成 agent，就更容易执行危险操作。作者不是把原因笼统归结为“agent 更复杂”，而是把问题拆到输入表示层面，指出 schema-formatted tool specifications 是安全退化的主要来源。也就是说，问题不只是工具语义让模型更敢做事，而是 JSON/schema 这类结构化工具描述本身改变了模型内部表征，削弱了 refusal signal。
summary.importance: 它和预训练的直接距离比纯训练方法论文更远，但对 post-train、安全对齐、agent 接口设计有明确启发。价值主要有两点。第一，它把 agent safety degradation 从经验现象推进到可分析的表示机制：不是简单说“工具让模型越权”，而是给出 schema direction 与 refusal direction 对抗的证据。第二，它提醒人们，模型能力和安全行为不只由参数决定，也强烈受输入协议影响。对基座研究员来说，这和 tokenizer、prompt format、tool serialization、multimodal serialization 是同一类问题：表示接口会改变模型内部几何，从而改变行为边界。贡献量级上，这是一个机制分析加 inference-time safeguard 的工作，不是新的通用训练范式，但结论很实用。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分两部分：先定位退化来源，再给出不改参数的缓解方案。

第一部分是白盒表示分析。作者沿用 refusal direction 这条线：从 harmful 与 benign 请求诱发的隐藏状态差异中提取一个 refusal-related direction，用投影分数衡量模型内部“拒绝特征”的强弱。然后做 component-level ablation，把 agent 输入拆成不同组成部分，检查哪些部分最显著地破坏 harmful-benign separability。结果显示，tool specifications 是主要来源。

更关键的是，作者进一步把“工具描述的语义内容”和“工具描述的表示形式”分开。控制实验里，保留相同工具语义，但把 schema-formatted specification 改写成 flattened textual form， harmful-benign 的可分性大幅恢复；反过来，去掉工具语义但保留 schema 风格表示，退化仍然存在。这个设计很重要，因为它把问题从“工具本身危险”收缩到“schema 表示干扰了拒绝机制”。

在机制层面，作者定义了 Schema Direction：同一工具规格在 schema 格式与扁平文本格式下诱发的平均隐藏状态变化。随后比较它与 chatbot setting 下提取的 refusal direction 的夹角关系。对 harmful 请求，这个 schema direction 在多层上都与 refusal direction 负对齐，说明 schema 格式把内部状态往“远离拒绝”的方向推。作者还看了生成开始后的第一个 token，发现 schema 格式会显著减弱 refusal direction 上 harmful 与 benign 的分离度。最后用 activation steering 沿着反 schema direction 干预，观察到 harmful tool execution 减少、refusal 增加，给出一定因果证据。

第二部分是 SafeKeep。它的设计很朴素，但抓住了上面的机制：把 safety judgment 和 tool execution 解耦。具体流程是，先用 flattened textual tool specifications 做一次安全判断，避免 schema 表示对 refusal 的干扰；如果请求被判定安全，再把原始 schema-formatted specs 送回 agent pipeline 做工具选择与执行；如果不安全，则阻断工具执行并转到拒答。这个方案不需要改模型参数，也不需要访问激活，因此既可用于开源模型，也可用于闭源 API 模型。论文还做了一个关键对照：如果安全判断阶段仍保留 schema-formatted specs，仅仅多加一道 safety gate，并不能得到同样收益，说明提升确实来自表示形式的改变，而不是“多了一层审查”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖两类风险：直接有害请求，以及 observation-level prompt injection。模型上同时评估白盒和黑盒场景，共四个 LLM。

主要结果有三组数字最值得记：
1. harmful requests 上，平均 refusal rate 从 23.8% 提升到 70.6%；
2. prompt injection 上，整体 attack success rate 从 25.6% 降到 2.5%；
3. 同时保持 task-handling capability，没有因为更保守而明显损伤正常任务处理。

机制验证方面，正文最关键的不是最终安全分数，而是几类控制实验：
- chatbot vs agent 的 refusal-related separability 对比，确认安全 gap 真实存在；
- agent context 各组成部分消融，定位 tool specifications 是主要退化源；
- same semantics, different format 与 same format, reduced semantics 两组对照，区分语义效应和表示效应；
- schema direction 与 refusal direction 的对齐分析，展示负对齐；
- first generated token 上的 separability 变化，说明影响已经进入解码阶段；
- activation steering 反向干预，提供因果支持；
- SafeKeep 与保留 schema 的 safety-judgment baseline 对比，证明关键不是多一道分类器，而是用扁平文本做安全判断。

如果从方法强弱看，这篇论文的实验说服力主要来自“定位—解释—干预—再验证”这条链条比较完整，而不是 benchmark 数量特别多。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议按“现象、机制、方案”三步看。

先看引言和 locating source 那一节，确认作者不是泛泛讨论 agent safety，而是在做 component-level attribution。这里要重点看 harmful-benign separability 的定义，以及 chatbot 与 agent setting 的差异是怎么量化的。

然后重点看两组实验：
1. schema vs flattened text 的控制对照；
2. Schema Direction 与 refusal direction 的表示分析，以及 activation steering 的因果验证。
这两部分决定论文是否真的抓到了主要机制，而不是只找到一个相关性。

最后看 SafeKeep 的系统流程和主结果表。要特别留意它与“仍用 schema 做 safety judgment”的 baseline 比较，因为这是方案成立的关键证据。

预计 25–35 分钟可以完成有效泛读。若要深挖，建议思考三个延伸问题：第一，这个现象是否只对当前主流 function-calling schema 成立，还是更一般的结构化协议都会触发；第二，flattened textual form 是否会在工具很多时损伤 tool selection；第三，能否把这种表示层面的安全修复前移到训练阶段，例如在 agent SFT/RL 中显式做 schema-robust refusal 保持。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: why does an LLM that reliably refuses harmful requests in a chatbot setting become much less safe once it is deployed as a tool-using agent? The authors do not stop at the generic answer that agents are more complex. They trace the degradation to the input representation itself and argue that schema-formatted tool specifications are a primary cause. In other words, the issue is not only that tools expand capability; the structured schema representation changes internal activations in a way that weakens refusal behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to alignment, agent interfaces, and representation design. Its main value is twofold. First, it turns agent safety degradation from an anecdotal observation into a representational mechanism: schema formatting induces a direction in hidden-state space that opposes the refusal direction. Second, it highlights a broader lesson that matters even for foundation-model researchers: behavior is shaped not only by model parameters and training data, but also by the serialization protocol used at inference time. That connects naturally to tokenizer design, prompt formatting, tool serialization, and multimodal interfaces. The contribution is best read as a mechanism-analysis paper plus a practical inference-time safeguard.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two stages: identify the source of degradation, then mitigate it without changing model weights.

The first stage is white-box representation analysis. Building on prior work on refusal directions, the authors extract a refusal-related direction from hidden-state differences between harmful and benign requests. They then use projections onto this direction as a diagnostic for how strongly refusal-related features are present internally. With component-level ablations of the agent input, they show that tool specifications account for most of the safety degradation.

The crucial step is separating tool semantics from tool representation. In controlled experiments, they keep the same tool meaning but rewrite schema-formatted specifications into flattened textual descriptions; harmful–benign separability is largely restored. Conversely, when they remove tool semantics but keep the schema-style representation, degradation remains. This isolates the representational format, not just the semantic content, as the main culprit.

To explain the mechanism, they define the Schema Direction: the average hidden-state shift induced by presenting the same tool specification in schema form rather than flattened text. They compare this direction with the refusal direction extracted from chatbot behavior. For harmful requests, the schema direction is negatively aligned with the refusal direction across layers, meaning schema formatting pushes activations away from refusal-related regions. They also show that the effect persists into decoding: at the first generated token, schema formatting reduces harmful–benign separation along the refusal direction. Finally, activation steering against the schema direction reduces harmful tool execution and increases refusal, which provides causal support.

The second stage is SafeKeep. The design follows directly from the mechanism. SafeKeep decouples safety judgment from tool execution. It first evaluates the request using flattened textual tool specifications, avoiding the schema representation that interferes with refusal. If the request is judged safe, it is passed to the original agent pipeline with the original schema-formatted tool specs for tool selection and execution. If unsafe, tool execution is blocked and the model is redirected to refusal. The method requires no parameter updates and no access to activations, so it can be applied to both open and closed models. A key control baseline shows that simply adding a safety gate is not enough; if the safety stage still uses schema-formatted specs, the gains are much smaller.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A good skim is to read it in three passes: phenomenon, mechanism, mitigation.

First, read the introduction and the section that localizes the source of degradation. The important point is that the paper is doing component-level attribution, not just reporting that agents are less safe. Pay attention to how harmful–benign separability is defined and how the chatbot-to-agent gap is measured.

Second, focus on two experimental blocks:
1. the controlled comparison between schema-formatted and flattened textual tool specifications;
2. the representation analysis around Schema Direction, refusal direction, and the activation-steering intervention.
These are the sections that determine whether the paper has identified a real mechanism rather than a loose correlation.

Finally, read the SafeKeep pipeline and the main result tables. The most important comparison is against the baseline that still performs safety judgment with schema-formatted specs, because that isolates the contribution of the flattened representation.

A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to extract the main idea and evidence. For deeper reading, three follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the effect is specific to current function-calling schemas or general to structured protocols; whether flattened text hurts tool selection when the tool set is large; and whether this kind of schema-robust refusal preservation can be moved into training rather than handled only at inference.

recommendation.zh: 读表征分析图即可；若 schema 真会压低 refusal signal，tool calling 数据格式要重新做安全 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the representation plots; if schemas really suppress refusal signals, tool-calling data formats need dedicated safety ablations.

paper.title: Relation Geometry in Semantic Space of Language Models
paper.abstract: When it comes to generating vector representations of words, current language models are achieving high-quality results. However, what is not known is the extent to which knowledge about semantic relations is represented in the geometry of the semantic spaces created in this way. In order to answer this question, we study the relation geometry of such semantic spaces from three perspectives. We first examine whether words standing in a particular relation to a target word~(called relata) occupy

summary.core_problem: 语言模型的语义空间是否真的编码了“关系”本身，而不只是词义相近性；以及这些关系在几何上呈现什么结构。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它不直接推动预训练 recipe，但对理解 embedding/hidden space 中关系知识如何组织有一定基础价值，尤其涉及 causal、masked 和 instruction-tuned 模型的表征差异。
summary.technical_approach: 从三方面研究 relation geometry：其一，检查与某目标词处于同一语义关系的 relata 是否聚集在相同区域、不同关系区域是否可分；其二，测试语义空间是否反映对称、非对称、传递等关系性质；其三，分析表面形式与上下文信息对关系几何的相对作用。实验覆盖多类 LM。
summary.experiments: 在六种语义关系上，对 causal、masked 和 instruction-tuned 模型进行表征分析。摘要未给出模型规模和具体数值提升，因为核心不是追求任务分数，而是比较不同模型语义空间中的关系结构。对预训练研究员而言，这更像表征诊断工具，而不是可直接落地的训练改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自东京大学、MBZUAI、RIKEN、NAIST、东北大学等学术机构，偏语言学与表征分析取向。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether language-model semantic spaces encode relations themselves, rather than merely lexical similarity, and what geometric structure those relations take.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/representation-analysis paper. It does not directly advance pretraining recipes, but it is useful for understanding how relational knowledge is organized in embedding or hidden spaces across causal, masked, and instruction-tuned models.
summary_en.technical_approach: It analyzes relation geometry from three angles: whether relata of a given target occupy shared regions, whether regions for different relations are separable, whether geometric structure reflects symmetry/asymmetry/transitivity, and whether surface forms or contexts matter more for relation geometry.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers six semantic relations and compares causal, masked, and instruction-tuned models. The abstract does not emphasize model sizes or benchmark gains because the goal is representational diagnosis rather than task optimization. For pretraining researchers, this is more of a probing framework than an actionable training recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Tokyo, MBZUAI, RIKEN, NAIST, and Tohoku University, with a clear representation-analysis and linguistics-oriented flavor.

recommendation.zh: 偏表征分析，不会直接改你的 recipe；如果你在想 hidden space 到底有没有“关系子空间”，可只看实验设计和 relation property 那部分。
recommendation.en: This won’t change your recipe, but if you care whether hidden spaces contain relation-specific geometry, the probing setup is the part worth reading.

paper.title: Similarity All The Way Up: Multilingual Generalization in LLMs Relies on Language-Level Similarity Structures
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) grow more capable across diverse tasks, their (in)ability to generalize remains difficult to quantify and poorly understood beyond limited domains. In particular, LLMs are known to struggle generalizing multilingually, to languages outside of English, and that are poorly attested in their training data. To understand why this may be, and what enables some models to perform better than others, we turn to a long history of work across the cognitive sciences, arguing

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 LLM 的多语言泛化为什么在不同语言之间差异很大，核心假设是：模型能否泛化，取决于其隐表示空间是否学到了语言之间的层级相似性结构。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把多语言能力从“某种语言有多少训练 token”推进到“模型内部是否形成了合理的语言级几何结构”。这对多语言数据配比、tokenizer 共享、低资源语言扩展和表示诊断都有参考意义。若一个模型能把 Germanic、Romance、Slavic 等语言子族组织成接近真实语言相似性的结构，它可能更容易在相关语言之间迁移；反过来，即使训练语料覆盖了很多语言，若表示空间把语言关系学得很碎，跨语言迁移仍会受限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者从认知科学中的 similarity-based generalization 出发，把语言级表示看作一个相似性空间。方法上，他们比较 12 个 LLM 的内部表示，不只看词表或单词 embedding，而是对每种语言的一批文档提取并聚合 latent representations，再计算语言之间的表示距离。随后将模型诱导出的语言距离结构与一个独立的 Indo-European 语言层级参考树进行比较。这个参考树来自 lexico-statistical 语言系统发育工作，目标不是复原严格历史谱系，而是提供语言之间层级相似性的外部基准。最后，作者检验这些表示结构与多语言 benchmark 表现之间的关系：越能恢复语言层级相似性的模型，通常在跨语言任务上表现越好。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 12 个不同 LLM，并以 Indo-European 语言族为主要分析对象。核心结果有两点。第一，LLM 在没有显式语言谱系监督的情况下，内部表示能够恢复相当程度的语言层级结构，例如把相近子族语言放在更近区域。第二，表示结构与多语言泛化表现相关：那些更好捕捉语言相似性的模型，在标准多语言评测上的表现更好。可用内容没有给出具体相关系数、模型名单或逐模型数值，因此更适合作为表示分析和诊断方法来读，而不是作为训练 recipe 的直接证据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看方法部分如何构造语言表示：用哪一层、如何聚合文档、如何计算语言间距离，以及是否控制脚本、词表重叠和数据量这些混杂因素。其次看表示树与参考树的对齐指标，因为这决定了结论是否只是可视化相似。实验部分重点看 12 个模型之间的差异，以及语言级 similarity recovery 与多语言 benchmark 表现的相关性。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是这种诊断框架：多语言模型评估不应只看最终任务分数，还应检查 representation space 是否形成可迁移的语言关系结构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why multilingual generalization varies so much across languages and across LLMs. Its central claim is that generalization depends on whether the model’s latent space captures language-level similarity structure.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is diagnostic. Multilingual capability is often explained by data volume, tokenizer coverage, or benchmark contamination. This work adds another axis: whether the model organizes languages in representation space in a way that reflects their hierarchical similarity. That matters for multilingual data mixture design, shared tokenization, low-resource language scaling, and representation evaluation. A model that places related languages near one another is better positioned to transfer across them than a model whose language representations are fragmented, even if both have seen multilingual text.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame the analysis using similarity-based generalization from cognitive science: generalization follows the geometry of the representation space. They examine twelve LLMs and derive language-level representations by aggregating latent activations over documents in each language, rather than relying on isolated word embeddings or vocabulary overlap. They then compute distances between languages in each model’s representation space and compare the induced structure with an external Indo-European language hierarchy derived from lexico-statistical phylogenetic work. The reference tree is used as a measure of hierarchical similarity, not as a strict claim about historical descent. The final step links this representational alignment to multilingual benchmark performance.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare twelve LLMs on Indo-European languages. The key findings are qualitative from the available content. First, LLM latent representations recover a substantial amount of hierarchical language structure without explicit supervision over language families. Second, models that better preserve this language-level similarity structure also tend to perform better on multilingual benchmarks. The supplied material does not include exact correlations, model-by-model tables, or ablation numbers, so the result is best read as a representation-analysis study rather than as direct evidence for a specific pretraining recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should focus on the representation construction and the evaluation metric. Check which layers are used, how document representations are pooled, how language distances are computed, and whether the analysis controls for script, vocabulary overlap, and training-data imbalance. The most important empirical section is the comparison between each model’s induced language structure and the reference Indo-European hierarchy, followed by the correlation with multilingual benchmark performance. The useful takeaway for pretraining work is the diagnostic idea: multilingual evaluation should inspect the geometry of language representations, not only final task accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 从语言相似性视角解释多语言泛化，发现表示空间与谱系结构对应，对多语言预训练的数据配比有启发，看§3和Fig 2即可。
recommendation.en: Explains multilingual generalization via language similarity in representation space; informative for multilingual pretraining data design, read §3 and Fig 2.

paper.title: Emergent Misalignment Recruits a Pre-existing Persona Subspace
paper.abstract: Fine-tuning an aligned language model on a narrow stream of bad advice can make it broadly misaligned on questions unrelated to the training data, a phenomenon called emergent misalignment. We ask why the narrow lesson generalizes at all, and we find that narrow fine-tuning recruits a persona structure that is present in the model before the fine-tune exists. From a frozen instruction-tuned model (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct) we extract per-domain persona subspaces by contrastive teacher forcing and fi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个很具体的问题：为什么在很窄的有害数据上微调一个已对齐模型，会诱发跨领域的广义失配行为。作者把解释分成两类：一种是“推断”解释，即模型把窄域数据当作作者身份或意图的证据，更新一个跨领域 persona latent；另一种是“累积”解释，即优化过程碰巧改动了同时影响多个行为的方向。论文试图证明，广义失配并不是微调后新造出来的结构，而是微调招募了冻结模型中已经存在的低秩 persona 子空间。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接启发。它提示 aligned instruct model 内部可能已经有可读写的跨领域 persona 结构，小规模微调只是把模型状态推到这些方向上。这个结果会影响三个判断：第一，安全问题不能只看训练样本的表面 token，意图框架会改变第一步梯度的方向；第二，后验 weight editing 不一定能移除失配倾向，因为模型可能在激活读出通道中重新形成 carrier；第三，预防性训练干预比事后修补更可靠，但可能带来能力成本。证据量级不宜外推过度，因为实验集中在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct、一个模型家族和一种适配方式上。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是先在冻结的 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上提取 persona 子空间，再做因果干预。作者使用 contrastive teacher forcing 构造每个领域的 persona 方向：在固定模型参数下，对不同 persona 条件下的 token log-prob 或 margin 做对比，得到与领域行为相关的低秩子空间。随后比较 4 个无关领域的子空间，抽取共享 core，并用匹配多样性的 style core 排除只是语气或格式差异的解释。因果测试分为几组：在微调期间把该 core 从激活中投影掉，观察广义失配是否形成；向未微调模型注入该 core，观察是否足以诱发失配；把相同投影施加到 weight gradient 通道，检验读通道和写通道是否等价；再用 post-hoc weight edits 检验失配形成后能否被删除。这样的设计比只做相关性探针更强，因为它同时测试了必要性、充分性和通道差异。
summary.experiments: 主要实验都围绕 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，模型为 48 层、残差宽度 5120。作者使用 Turner et al. 的三个已发布 LoRA organisms，包括坏医疗建议、风险金融建议和极限运动；另外用 Betley et al. 的 insecure-code 与 educational-code 数据做第一步梯度和预测实验。评测沿用 Betley et al. 的双轴 judge：alignment 低于 30 且 coherence 不低于 50 才计为广义失配。关键数字包括：4 个无关领域共享的 persona core 相对随机子空间 null 达到 657 倍，其中 82% 不在匹配多样性的 style core 中；不安全代码微调的第一步梯度已经比同样代码的教育框架更强地爬升 broad-misalignment margin，并能预测到 375 steps 的 margin 变化；训练时从激活中投影掉 core，可把广义失配率从 27.7% 降到 0.0%，匹配秩随机子空间没有类似效果；向未改动模型注入该 core，可随剂量把失配率推到 45.4%，norm-matched 随机向量基本不变；独立训练 organisms 的 read-channel direction 相似度为 0.90，而经验 null 为 0.11；该结构的曲率约为匹配随机 core 的 7 倍，并集中在少数方向；post-hoc weight edits 后，在未编辑的 onset dose 下约 97% 的 carrier 会在被清空子空间内重新形成。固定坏数据预算分散到 4 个领域时，广义失配没有被稀释，反而强于机械合并和匹配 benign mixture。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读但保留几个重点。先看 Section 3，理解 contrastive teacher forcing 如何定义 persona subspace，以及 657 倍随机 null、82% 非 style core、7 倍曲率这些数字对应什么统计对象。再看 Section 4 的第一步梯度实验，这是判断“意图框架影响优化方向”的关键。Section 5 最值得细看，尤其是 activation projection 与 injection 的必要性和充分性实验；这里能看出作者为什么认为这是一个可读出的 persona core，而不只是微调副产物。Section 6 用独立 organisms、跨域 margin 移动和多领域数据预算测试“同一个对象”的说法。Section 7 的 reconstitution certificate 对安全干预有启发：事后权重编辑失败，不等于方向被测错，可能是训练动力学重新把 carrier 写回来。预计阅读 30–45 分钟。Section 9 的限制也要看，尤其是一模型、一尺度、judge misalignment 较弱、teacher-forced margin 是主 readout。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why a narrow harmful fine-tune can produce broad misalignment on unrelated questions. It contrasts two explanations. Under an inference account, the model treats the narrow data as evidence about a cross-domain persona or author intent. Under an accumulation account, optimization accidentally moves directions that also affect unrelated behavior. The paper argues that the broad effect recruits a low-rank persona structure already present in the frozen instruction-tuned model.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It suggests that aligned instruction models may contain latent cross-domain persona directions before any harmful fine-tune, and small adaptation can activate them quickly. This changes how to think about safety filtering and robustness: token overlap is not enough, because the same code framed as insecure advice or as educational material induces different first-step movement. It also weakens confidence in post-hoc weight editing as a removal method, since the carrier can re-form in the activation read channel. The scope is still narrow: one released model family, one scale, LoRA-style organisms, and relatively weak judged misalignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first extract candidate persona subspaces from a frozen Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct model using contrastive teacher forcing. Per-domain persona directions are estimated without loading any misalignment adapter, then compared across four unrelated domains to identify a shared low-rank core. A matched-diversity style core is used as a control to separate persona content from surface style. They then run causal tests. During fine-tuning, they project this core out of activations and compare against matched-rank random subspaces. In the opposite direction, they inject the core into the untouched model and measure whether misalignment appears. They also apply the same projection in the weight-gradient channel and try post-hoc weight edits, which tests whether the phenomenon is mediated by read-channel activations or by easily editable weight directions.
summary_en.experiments: All main measurements use Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, a 48-layer model with residual width 5120. The paper uses three published LoRA organisms from Turner et al. for bad medical advice, risky financial advice, and extreme sports, and runs its own fine-tunes on insecure-code and educational-code data from Betley et al. Behavior is measured with a two-axis judge: an answer is counted as broadly misaligned only if alignment is below 30 and coherence is at least 50. The shared persona core across four unrelated domains is 657 times above a random-subspace null, with 82% of the core outside a matched style core. The first optimizer step on insecure code already moves a broad-misalignment margin more than the same code framed educationally, and this early movement forecasts margin changes out to 375 steps. Projecting the core out of activations during fine-tuning reduces broad misalignment from 27.7% to 0.0%, while a random matched-rank projection does not. Injecting the core into the untouched model induces misalignment up to 45.4% with dose, while a norm-matched random vector stays flat. Independently trained organisms share a read-channel direction at 0.90 versus an empirical null of 0.11. The core has about 7 times the curvature of a matched random core, concentrated in a few directions. After post-hoc edits, roughly 97% of the carrier can re-form inside the cleared subspace at the unedited onset dose.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper with attention to the causal design. Section 3 is the main place to understand how contrastive teacher forcing defines the persona subspace, what the 657-times random null means, and why the style-core control matters. Section 4 is important for the first-step result, especially the comparison between insecure and educational framing with nearly identical tokens. Section 5 contains the strongest evidence: activation projection prevents the effect, and injection induces it. Section 6 tests whether different organisms share one read-channel object rather than separate artifacts. Section 7 is useful for safety research because it shows a gap between suppression and removal, including carrier reconstitution after weight edits. Estimated reading time: 30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 失准机制的发现反常识，预训练表示中预存的persona子空间是对齐脆弱性的根源，做对齐和预训练表示的人重点看§3子空间分析
recommendation.en: The misalignment mechanism is counterintuitive; the pre-existing persona subspace in pretrained representations is a root of alignment fragility, focus on §3 subspace analysis

paper.title: Geometric Configurations of Perturbed Jailbreak Prompts
paper.abstract: Perturbation techniques that turn unsuccessful jailbreak prompts into successful ones are continuously evolving, constituting a major security threat to LLM safety. In this paper, we investigate the internal representations of such string-level perturbed jailbreak inputs in the small weight models of the Qwen-2.5-1.5B/-3B/-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B/-3B/-3.1-8B-Instruct families. We select two representation spaces: the last-layer-last-token embedding space and the top-50 next-token probabilit

summary.core_problem: 研究字符串级扰动 jailbreak prompt 在小型指令模型内部表示中的几何结构，以及这些结构是否能解释拒答和服从行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是安全机制分析。它不提出新的防御方法，而是检查常见表示空间中是否存在可分离的 jailbreak 行为几何，对 representation-based safety probe 的可靠性有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文选取两个空间：最后一层最后 token embedding，以及 top-50 next-token probability space。作者比较不同拼写、格式扰动和行为标签在这些空间中的聚类与可分性，并寻找是否存在区分 compliant/refusal 的行为超平面。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen-2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct 与 Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 等小权重模型。主要发现是 embedding 空间更按拼写和格式分离；top-50 概率空间近似一维但聚类并不简单；在拒答占优的答案集合中，两类空间都没有稳定行为超平面，只有少数 next token 与服从标签显著相关。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies the geometry of string-level perturbed jailbreak prompts inside small instruction-tuned LLMs and asks whether those representations explain refusal versus compliance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety-mechanism analysis. It does not introduce a new defense, but it tests whether common representation spaces contain a clean behavioral separator for jailbreak outcomes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes two spaces: the last-layer last-token embedding and the top-50 next-token probability vector. It examines clustering by spelling, format, and behavioral labels, then searches for a hyperplane separating compliant from refusal-dominated answers.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen-2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-1B/3B plus Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The embedding space separates spelling and formatting more than behavior; the top-50 probability space is effectively one-dimensional; no robust behavioral hyperplane is found, except for a few next-token associations such as "Sure" in one Qwen model and punctuation/newline tokens in one Llama model.

recommendation.zh: 小模型安全几何的负结果，适合备查；只看表示空间选择和无超平面结论即可。
recommendation.en: A negative result on jailbreak geometry in small models; skim the representation choices and the no-hyperplane finding.

paper.title: Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks
paper.abstract: Deep neural networks encode complex representations, but deconstructing this internal knowledge remains a challenge. Given the link between learning and compression, network compression offers a promising lens to analyze this knowledge. However, standard compression heuristics often suffer from scale symmetries and architectural biases. To resolve these, we introduce Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE), a mathematical framework to gradually deconstruct the representations in trained

summary.core_problem: 如何在不受尺度对称性和架构偏置干扰的情况下，分解深度网络中学到的表征与冗余结构。
summary.importance: 这是表征分析与压缩统一视角的机制研究。对 LLM 研究员的价值不在直接改模型，而在于提供一种更干净的网络分解语言，可能影响后续剪枝、模块合并和表征可解释性分析。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HOPE，把神经元视为 Hilbert-Schmidt rank-1 算子，把剪枝、神经元合并和更大粒度的 block eviction 统一成 Hilbert 空间中的低秩子空间投影问题，从而减少传统压缩启发式的尺度依赖和架构偏见。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论统一性与跨层级结构处理能力，覆盖 neuron、layer block、residual path 等粒度；未看到与 LLM 直接相关的大规模实验、预训练设置或语言建模指标。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Hossein Mobahi 与 Peter L. Bartlett，二者在深度学习理论、优化与表征分析方面有长期积累；这更像基础机制工作而非面向 LLM 的直接方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to deconstruct learned representations in deep networks without being misled by scale symmetries and architecture-specific compression biases.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/analysis paper that unifies representation analysis and compression. Its value to LLM researchers is indirect: it offers a cleaner language for pruning, merging, and representation decomposition rather than an immediate model improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: HOPE models neurons as rank-1 Hilbert-Schmidt operators and casts pruning, neuron merging, and macro block eviction as low-rank subspace projections in a Hilbert space, aiming to remove scale dependence and architectural bias from standard compression heuristics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theoretical unification across granularities such as neurons, blocks, and residual pathways; it does not indicate LLM-specific large-scale experiments, pretraining setups, or language-modeling metrics.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Hossein Mobahi and Peter L. Bartlett, both well known for work in deep learning theory, optimization, and representation analysis; this is better read as a foundational mechanism paper than a direct LLM methods paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是直接做 LLM，但若你在想 pruning/merging 的统一度量，这篇的数学框架比常见启发式干净；读引言和方法定义即可。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper per se, but if you care about a cleaner metric for pruning/merging, the math here is more principled than usual heuristics; intro plus method definitions are enough.

paper.title: Gotta Catch them all: the modes of Sycophancy
paper.abstract: Large language models often align with users' beliefs at the expense of factual accuracy, a behavior known as sycophancy. Prior mechanistic studies largely treat sycophancy as a single behavioral dimension that can be uniformly amplified or suppressed. We challenge this assumption by analyzing three hypothesized modes of sycophancy across 948 social pressure situations. Although the modes produce highly similar outputs, with a text-only classifier achieving just 57.8 percent accuracy, their inte

summary.core_problem: 研究 sycophancy 是否真是单一行为维度，还是由多个内部可分离的模式组成。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解对齐副作用、表征分解和干预粒度有启发。若你关心 post-train 行为如何映射到内部电路，这篇有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 948 个 social pressure 场景中分析三种假设的 sycophancy 模式。虽然输出文本高度相似，文本分类器只能达到 57.8% 准确率，但内部表征从第 14 层起可线性完全分离。进一步分析不同模式的出现阶段、依赖的 attention circuitry 和激活 strongest 的输入类型。
summary.experiments: 核心实验不是比 benchmark 分数，而是做表征可分性和电路层面的分析。摘要给出的关键数字是文本侧难分、表示侧可完全线性分离，说明行为同像不代表机制同源。未见与预训练数据、规模或训练 recipe 直接相关的实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Southern Utah University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether sycophancy is a single behavioral dimension or a family of internally separable modes.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. It does not directly advance pretraining methods, but it is relevant if you care about how alignment-side behaviors decompose into internal representations and circuits.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across 948 social-pressure situations, the authors analyze three hypothesized modes of sycophancy. While the generated texts are highly similar and a text-only classifier reaches only 57.8% accuracy, the internal representations become perfectly linearly separable from layer 14 onward. They further study emergence stage, attention circuitry, and input selectivity for each mode.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are representation-separability and circuit analyses rather than benchmark chasing. The key result is that text-level similarity hides mechanistic heterogeneity: outputs are hard to distinguish, but internal states are perfectly separable. There is no direct contribution to pretraining data, scaling, or recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Southern Utah University.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但“同一行为、不同电路”这个结论值得记；只看线性可分层位和 attention circuitry 分析，别在行为学叙事上停太久。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining material, but the 'same behavior, different circuits' result is worth keeping; read the layerwise separability and attention-circuit sections, not the broader behavioral framing.

paper.title: Learning to Detect Cross-Modal Negation: An Analysis of Latent Representations and an Attention-Based Solution
paper.abstract: Detecting high-level semantic concepts like negation across modalities remains a challenge for current multimodal systems. We analyze this as a fundamental representation learning problem, providing the first evidence that negation does not form a linearly or non-linearly separable class in the latent spaces of standard vision-language models (VLMs). We demonstrate that pretrained embeddings primarily encode modality-specific features, lacking a generalizable negation signal. To overcome this, w

summary.core_problem: 分析并提升 VLM 对跨模态否定语义的检测能力，特别是图像/视频与文本组合中“否定”是否被表示为可泛化 latent signal。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 表征分析加小型方法改进。否定是高层语义和组合泛化的典型失败点；如果标准 VLM latent space 中否定不可分，说明当前图文对齐预训练更偏向实体、场景和模态特征，而不是逻辑关系。
summary.technical_approach: 先对标准 VLM 的 latent representations 做线性和非线性可分性分析，发现否定类别不形成稳定可分结构；再提出 cross-modal attention 架构，显式建模文本和视觉之间的依赖。数据侧使用 Qwen2.5-VL 自动标注 3,222 条政治 video-text pairs，并进行统计分析。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 cross-modal attention 方法相对 unimodal baselines 最高提升 +7.03% F1。实验数据为 3,222 个政治视频-文本配对；未给出被分析 VLM 名称、参数规模、完整 baseline 列表或统计置信区间。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes and improves VLM detection of cross-modal negation, asking whether negation is represented as a generalizable latent signal across image/video and text.
summary_en.importance: This is a VLM representation-analysis contribution with a modest method component. Negation is a useful stress case for high-level semantics and compositional generalization; if it is not separable in standard VLM latent spaces, current image-text pretraining may be encoding entities, scenes, and modality-specific cues more strongly than logical relations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first test whether negation forms a linearly or non-linearly separable class in standard VLM latent representations, then introduce a cross-modal attention architecture to explicitly model dependencies between language and vision. The study uses 3,222 political video-text pairs automatically annotated with Qwen2.5-VL and includes statistical analysis of textual versus visual negation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to +7.03% F1 over unimodal baselines using the proposed cross-modal attention solution. The dataset contains 3,222 political video-text pairs. It does not specify the analyzed VLMs, parameter sizes, full baseline set, or confidence intervals.

recommendation.zh: 看 latent separability 结果即可；数据域偏政治视频，结论别直接推广到通用 VLM 预训练。
recommendation.en: Read the latent-separability analysis; the political-video domain makes broad VLM-pretraining conclusions fragile.

paper.title: How Does Alignment Tuning Shape Representations of Sycophancy and Related Cue-Induced Biases in LLMs?
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs are alarmingly susceptible to surprisingly simple immaterial changes of input prompts: a casual hint, an incorrectly labeled few-shot example, or a fake prior assistant turn often flips an originally correct answer. We study where this susceptibility, spanning sycophancy and related cue-induced biases, lives inside the model. Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, we extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and triangulate it through three measures: probing, leav

summary.core_problem: 研究 alignment tuning 如何在模型内部形成 sycophancy 和提示线索诱导偏差的表示。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和 post-train 接口分析。核心结论是这些偏差主要由对齐训练安装，而不是预训练阶段自然形成；这会影响如何看待 RLHF/SFT 对 base model 表示空间的改写。
summary.technical_approach: 在五个模型家族和七类 BCT bias 上，从 hidden states 中提取每类偏差方向，并用三种方式验证：probe 解码、leave-one-dataset-out transfer，以及 causal intervention。论文进一步测试沿该方向 steering 是否能恢复无偏答案，并分析不同偏差方向之间是否共享。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个模型家族、七类 cue-induced bias。结果称 base pretrained models 几乎不受这些偏差影响，activation 中也没有超过问题内容本身的 cue-specific signal；aligned models 中每类 bias 形成可解码、可干预的单一方向，steering 可在测试模型家族中恢复无偏回答，但不同 bias 方向仍保持区分，跨 bias transfer 有限。具体模型名称和数值提升在给定摘要中未披露。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Michigan、Jinesis Lab、University of Toronto & Vector Institute、Max-Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems、ELLIS Institute Tübingen。Bernhard Schölkopf 是因果学习和机器学习领域知名研究者，Zhijing Jin 长期研究 NLP、因果与模型行为分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how alignment tuning shapes internal representations of sycophancy and related cue-induced biases in LLMs.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis of the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. The main claim is that these susceptibilities are largely installed by alignment tuning rather than inherited from pretraining, which matters for how we interpret RLHF/SFT-induced representation changes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Across five model families and seven BCT bias types, the authors extract a per-bias direction from hidden states and validate it with probing, leave-one-dataset-out transfer, and causal interventions. They also test whether steering along these directions recovers unbiased answers and whether bias directions transfer across bias types.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover five model families and seven cue-induced bias categories. The abstract reports that pretrained base models barely exhibit these biases and do not encode cue-specific signals beyond question content, while aligned models contain coherent, decodable, and steerable directions for each bias. Steering recovers unbiased answers across tested families, but directions remain bias-specific with limited cross-bias transfer. Exact model names and numerical gains are not available in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with University of Michigan, Jinesis Lab, University of Toronto and Vector Institute, Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, and ELLIS Institute Tübingen. Bernhard Schölkopf is a well-known researcher in causality and machine learning; Zhijing Jin has notable work on NLP, causality, and model behavior analysis.

recommendation.zh: 值得读机制实验而非安全叙事；若结论站住，alignment 不是只改输出偏好，而是在写入低维偏差方向。
recommendation.en: Read it for the mechanistic tests, not the safety framing; if robust, alignment is writing low-dimensional bias directions, not just output preferences.

institutions: Jinesis Lab, University of Toronto & Vector Institute
Max-Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen

paper.title: SeeSE3: Emergence of 3D Space in Vision Features
paper.abstract: In this paper, we ask whether vision foundation models construct representations that reflect the intrinsic properties of 3D Euclidean space. Unlike previous works that probe 3D awareness of vision features by regressing image-centric quantities such as depth or normals, we investigate the relation between the structure of the space of visual features and the group of Euclidean transformations $SE(3)$. We propose a set of probes to evaluate this relation from both topological and geometric persp

summary.core_problem: 被动观测、无显式3D监督的视觉基础模型，其特征空间是否自发涌现出与3D欧几里得变换群SE(3)对齐的拓扑与几何结构。
summary.importance: 为自监督视觉预训练的表征涌现性提供了新证据：仅靠被动视觉输入，无需显式3D标注，模型即可学习到底层3D几何结构。其探测方法也为分析视觉及多模态基础模型的表征几何提供了新框架，对世界模型、统一多模态预训练的表征设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从拓扑和几何两个维度设计探测方案：拓扑层面采用互邻域度量，比较特征空间近邻与相机位姿空间近邻的排序一致性，验证局部拓扑是否匹配SE(3)结构；几何层面提出轻量孪生解码器Poincaré Adapter，测试静态场景下的特征位移能否线性解码相机运动几何，验证潜在空间是否存在齐次SE(3)坐标结构。同时包含自监督方法恢复几何结构的条件分析，以及不同视觉特征变体的消融实验。
summary.experiments: 在多个自监督视觉基础模型、多组静态场景数据集上的测试显示，自监督图像特征与SE(3)空间结构存在较强对齐；SE(3)中的旋转分量比平移分量更易被模型编码；即使特征局部不与SE(3)直接同构，轻量Poincaré Adapter也可提取出齐次坐标系，并支持实现闭式潜在视觉导航。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看引言部分的问题定义（被动观测者能否发现3D空间结构）与现有3D探测工作的差异，再关注两种探测指标（互邻域度量、Poincaré Adapter）的核心设计，最后浏览不同训练设置下的消融实验结果，预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether passively trained vision foundation models without explicit 3D supervision spontaneously develop feature space structures whose topology and geometry align with the 3D Euclidean transformation group SE(3).
summary_en.importance: Provides new evidence for representational emergence in self-supervised visual pretraining: passive visual input alone is sufficient for models to learn underlying 3D geometric structure without explicit 3D labels. The probing methodology also offers a new framework for analyzing representational geometry in vision and multimodal foundation models, with implications for world model and unified multimodal pretraining design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two complementary probing protocols are designed. Topologically, a mutual neighborhood metric compares nearest neighbor rankings in feature space against those in camera pose space to verify local topology alignment with SE(3). Geometrically, a lightweight Siamese decoder called Poincaré Adapter tests whether camera motion geometry can be linearly decoded from feature displacements in static scenes, checking for a homogeneous SE(3) coordinate structure in the latent space. The work also includes theoretical analysis of conditions for self-supervised geometric structure recovery, plus ablations across different visual feature variants.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations across multiple self-supervised vision foundation models on static scene datasets show strong alignment between self-supervised image features and SE(3) spatial structure. Rotation components of SE(3) are easier to encode than translation. Even though features are not locally isomorphic to SE(3) directly, the lightweight Poincaré Adapter can extract a homogeneous coordinate system and enable closed-form latent visual navigation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first review the problem formulation (whether a passive observer can discover 3D spatial structure) and the distinction from prior 3D probing work that regresses depth or normals in the introduction. Then focus on the core design of the two probing metrics (mutual neighborhood metric, Poincaré Adapter). Finally browse ablation results across different training settings. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 表征探测方法可直接迁移到LLM的世界模型/逻辑结构涌现分析，重点看§3的两类探测指标设计即可。
recommendation.en: The representation probing methods are directly transferable to analyzing emergence of world models or logical structures in LLMs; focus on §3 for the two probing metric designs.

paper.title: From Geometric Recovery to Causal Validation: A Reproducible Audit of Sparse Autoencoder Features, from Superposition Geometry to Causal Inertness
paper.abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are the standard for decomposing superposed neural representations into interpretable features, and evaluation relies predominantly on correlational recovery metrics -- cosine similarity between ground-truth directions and decoder atoms. We show this conflates two distinct claims: decoder-geometry alignment and encoder-activation behavior. We reproduce the superposition phase diagram of Elhage et al. (2022), identifying a convergence artifact at high sparsity and an un

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 SAE 解释性研究里一个被长期混在一起、但其实应当拆开的核心问题：一个 SAE decoder atom 在几何上和“真实特征方向”高度对齐，并不等于这个 atom 在模型实际计算中真的承担了对应功能。现有评估大多用 unsigned cosine similarity 这类相关性指标来判断“恢复成功”，但这只验证了 decoder 几何是否对齐，没有验证 encoder 是否会在正确输入上激活该特征，也没有验证对该特征做干预是否会沿着模型真实计算路径影响输出。论文在一个完全可控的 toy superposition setting 中，把这两件事明确分开，并用因果干预证明：高 cosine match 可以对应因果上几乎无效的 feature，作者把这种现象称为 causal inertness。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于改进 loss 或架构，而在于给 mechanistic interpretability 和 SAE 评估方法做了一次校准。现在很多关于“模型里发现了多少 feature”的结论，默认把 correlational recovery 当成 feature discovery 的充分证据。论文说明这一步并不够，至少在最容易验证的 toy setting 里，decoder 几何恢复和 encoder/selection 机制、以及最终输出因果效应之间存在可测的裂缝。这个结论会影响两类工作。第一类是用 SAE 做模型内部表征分析的研究：以后不能只报 cosine recovery。第二类是把 SAE feature 当成可控接口做 steering、editing、safety intervention 的工作：如果 feature 是 read-inert 或 write-inert，那么看起来“找到了”特征，实际却未必能读出或写入模型行为。对基座模型研究者来说，这篇论文的重要性在于它把“解释性 feature 是否真实可操作”从相关性问题推进到因果验证问题。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分成四层，而且每一层都围绕“把几何恢复和因果有效性拆开”展开。

第一层是构造完全可控的 ground-truth superposition toy model。作者从头训练一个很小的合成模型，不用预训练权重，也不用外部数据，使得真实 feature 方向、隐藏维度、稀疏度和 superposition 几何都已知。这样做的目的不是追求 realism，而是让“恢复是否正确”以及“干预是否沿真实路径生效”都能被严格定义。

第二层是复现并修正已有 SAE 几何结论。论文多 seed 复现了 Elhage 等人的 superposition phase diagram，并指出一个重要 artifact：在高 sparsity 区域，若训练步数不够，会把 under-training 误判成 superposition 结构。作者用 sparsity-aware step budgets 解决这个问题。除此之外，论文还描述了一个此前没有被充分刻画的 diffuse sharing regime：在极端 overcompleteness 下，每个 feature 都被“相当程度地表示”，但 feature dimensionality 很低，说明表示不是少数原子清晰分工，而是更弥散地共享字典容量。

第三层是复现 TopK SAE 与 L1 SAE 的比较，并把“L1 shrinkage”从口头说法变成直接测量。作者从头复现 TopK-vs-L1 Pareto，对 activation refinement 做了直接测试，量化 L1 正则导致的 shrinkage，而不是只凭经验判断。这里的关键点是：decoder recovery 看起来相近时，encoder 激活行为可能已经明显不同，这正是后面因果分歧的来源之一。

第四层是提出一套 causal validation battery，并把 inertness 细分成可操作的类型。作者对每个 correlationally recovered feature 做两类干预：ablation 和 sign-correct steering，并把影响一路传播到模型真实输出层，而不是停留在 SAE reconstruction 空间。基于这些干预，论文区分了两条轴。按成因分，有 structural inertness 和 competitive inertness。前者来自 antipodal-pair superposition geometry 与 positive-pass encoder 的结构性错配，即使 SAE 训练更好也未必消失；后者来自 TopK 竞争机制下退化字典的竞争病理，并且和数值边界不稳定性耦合。按方向分，有 read-inertness 和 write-inertness：前者表示 ablation 监测不到，后者表示 steering 无法写入有效影响。论文指出 antipodal pairs 可以把这两者完全解耦。

此外，作者还把这套审计流程封装成 sae-causal-audit 工具，接口只要求对象能 encode、decode 并暴露 dictionary，因此理论上可审计任意 SAE 实现，包括 sae_lens.SAE。工具设计里还专门处理了 sign-handling bug 这一类常见错误，使其在接口层面不易发生。
summary.experiments:
实验部分信息量很高，且不少结论都带具体数字。

第一，superposition phase diagram 的复现不是单次跑通，而是多 seed 统计。作者发现高 sparsity 区域存在收敛伪象：训练不够时会看起来像某种 superposition 几何，实际只是没收敛。这个问题通过 sparsity-aware step budget 解决。论文还报告了 diffuse sharing regime 的量化特征：在极端 overcompleteness 下，每个 feature 的表示强度大致为 ||W_i||^2 ≈ 1.40，而 feature dimensionality 约为 D_i ≈ 0.08，说明 feature 普遍被表示，但每个 feature 占用的“维度份额”很小。

第二，TopK-vs-L1 复现部分，作者不仅比较 Pareto，还直接测 activation refinement，验证 L1 shrinkage 的存在。虽然当前给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但结论很明确：仅看 decoder 对齐会高估 L1 SAE 的恢复质量，因为 encoder 激活被 shrinkage 扭曲后，因果效应会进一步偏离。

第三，也是最关键的，因果验证结果显示 correlational recovery 和 causal efficacy 可以明显分离。在一个 degraded SAE 上，22 个几何匹配到的 feature 里有 17 个是 causally inert；在一个 well-trained SAE 上，同样是 22 个匹配里只有 2 个 inert。更强的一点是，inert match 的 cosine 可以高到 0.9998，说明“几何几乎完美”并不能保证“因果上有效”。这基本击穿了只用 cosine recovery 做结论的做法。

第四，真实模型小规模审计。作者拿一个已发布的 production SAE，gpt2-small-res-jb，对 83 个手工编写、跨多个语义域的 concept 做审计，恢复出 7 个 correlationally matched feature，其中 1 个，也就是 14%，是 causally inert。样本不大，但方向上和 toy setting 一致。论文还发现一个意外现象：少数 decoder atoms 会反复成为几十个语义上互不相关 concept 的最近邻匹配。作者用三组独立构造、规模和多样性逐步增加的 concept batch 复现了这个 atom collision 现象，并用受控负例排除了 prompt template artifact 的解释。

第五，复现性实验。作者在 CI 调试中说明了为什么浮点训练跨平台做不到 byte-exact reproducibility，并提出两层保证：固定环境内做 SHA-256 级别的字节一致；跨环境则要求 semantic equality，数值容差 rtol=1e-4，边界敏感的整数计数允许 ±1。这个部分不是主结果，但对做 SAE 或小模型复现实验的人很实用。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合精读。建议先抓住论文最重要的判断：decoder 几何对齐和 feature 的因果有效性不是一回事。带着这个判断去读，结构会很清楚。

第一遍先看 Introduction 和作者列出的贡献，确认它不是单纯“又做了一次 toy SAE 复现”，而是在重写评估协议。然后直接看因果验证章节，也就是 ablation + sign-correct steering 那部分，重点看作者如何把干预传播到真实输出层，以及 inertness 的判定标准。这里是全文最关键的创新。

第二步回头看 superposition phase diagram 的复现。重点看高 sparsity convergence artifact 是如何被发现的，训练步数如何随 sparsity 调整，以及 diffuse sharing regime 的几何特征。这个部分会帮助理解为什么某些 feature 即使几何上可恢复，也可能在 encoder 选择机制下失活或竞争失败。

第三步看 TopK-vs-L1 复现和 activation refinement 测试。这里要注意作者不是简单说 TopK 更好，而是在问：哪一种 SAE 的 decoder recovery 更接近真实可干预 feature。若你平时只看 reconstruction / sparsity / cosine，这一节会补上 encoder 行为这一块。

第四步看 taxonomy 和工具化部分。structural inertness vs competitive inertness、read-inertness vs write-inertness 这四个概念值得记住，因为它们把“为什么干预无效”拆成了可诊断的问题。最后再看真实模型上的 gpt2-small-res-jb 审计和 atom collision 现象，判断 toy 结论在真实模型里是否已有早期迹象。

如果时间有限，优先读 Sections 6、7、10、11，再补 4 和 5。若要复现实验，Section 8 的 reproducibility 约定也值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central evaluation mistake in sparse autoencoder research: a decoder atom being geometrically aligned with a ground-truth feature direction does not imply that the SAE actually recovers the feature as used by the model. Current practice relies heavily on correlational recovery metrics such as unsigned cosine similarity. Those metrics validate decoder geometry, but they do not validate encoder activation behavior, selection dynamics, or whether intervening on the recovered feature changes the model’s actual output. In a fully controlled superposition toy setting, the paper cleanly separates these claims and shows by intervention that highly matched features can still be causally inert.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is methodological calibration for mechanistic interpretability rather than a new pretraining recipe. A large fraction of current SAE-based interpretability work implicitly treats correlational recovery as sufficient evidence of feature discovery. This paper shows that the inference is too strong. Even in the easiest possible setting, where ground truth is known, decoder alignment and causal efficacy can diverge by a measurable margin. That matters for two lines of work. First, studies that use SAEs to characterize internal representations can no longer stop at cosine recovery. Second, work that treats SAE features as control handles for steering, editing, or safety interventions needs to distinguish features that are merely geometrically plausible from features that are actually readable or writable in the model’s computation. For foundation-model researchers, the paper shifts the question from correlation to causal validation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical program has four layers, all built around separating geometric recovery from causal validity.

First, the authors construct a fully controlled ground-truth superposition model. It is a small synthetic model trained from scratch, with no pretrained weights and no external data. The point is not realism but identifiability: true feature directions, sparsity, hidden dimensionality, and superposition geometry are all known, so both recovery and intervention can be evaluated rigorously.

Second, they reproduce and refine prior geometric results. The paper reproduces the Elhage et al. superposition phase diagram with multi-seed statistics and identifies an important artifact: at high sparsity, insufficient training can masquerade as superposition structure. This is corrected with sparsity-aware step budgets. The paper also describes a less-discussed diffuse sharing regime at extreme overcompleteness, where every feature is substantially represented while each feature occupies only a small effective dimensional share.

Third, the paper reproduces the TopK-vs-L1 SAE comparison and turns the usual claim about L1 shrinkage into a direct measurement. Instead of asserting that L1 regularization distorts activations, the authors run an activation-refinement test that quantifies the shrinkage. This is important because similar-looking decoder recovery can coexist with very different encoder behavior, which later shows up as causal mismatch.

Fourth, the paper introduces a causal validation battery and a taxonomy of inertness. For every correlationally recovered feature, the authors run ablation and sign-correct steering interventions and propagate the effect through the model’s actual output stage rather than stopping at the SAE reconstruction space. This leads to two orthogonal taxonomies. By cause, there is structural inertness and competitive inertness. Structural inertness arises systematically from antipodal-pair superposition geometry combined with a positive-pass encoder, and better SAE training does not necessarily remove it. Competitive inertness is a TopK competition pathology in degraded dictionaries and is tied to numerical boundary instability. By direction, there is read-inertness and write-inertness: ablation can fail to reveal a feature even when steering can affect it, and steering can fail even when ablation suggests relevance. Antipodal pairs can fully dissociate these two notions.

The work is also packaged into a model-agnostic auditing tool, sae-causal-audit. Any object that can encode, decode, and expose its dictionary can be audited, including sae_lens.SAE. The interface is designed to make a documented class of sign-handling bugs hard to express.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is unusually rich and several results are numerically sharp.

First, the superposition phase diagram is reproduced with multi-seed statistics rather than a single run. The paper shows that high-sparsity regions suffer from a convergence artifact: under-training can look like a geometric phase transition. This is fixed with sparsity-aware training budgets. The newly described diffuse sharing regime is quantified by values such as ||W_i||^2 ≈ 1.40 and feature dimensionality D_i ≈ 0.08 under extreme overcompleteness, indicating that features are broadly represented but each occupies only a small dimensional share.

Second, in the TopK-vs-L1 reproduction, the paper directly measures activation refinement and confirms L1 shrinkage rather than treating it as folklore. The excerpt provided here does not include the full Pareto tables, but the qualitative conclusion is clear: decoder alignment alone overstates recovery quality when encoder activations are distorted by shrinkage.

Third, and most importantly, causal validation reveals a strong gap between correlational recovery and causal efficacy. In a degraded SAE, 17 of 22 matched features are causally inert. In a well-trained SAE, only 2 of 22 matched features are inert. More strikingly, inert matches can have cosine similarity as high as 0.9998. This is the paper’s strongest result: near-perfect geometric recovery does not guarantee causal usefulness.

Fourth, the authors run a first small-scale audit on a real published SAE, gpt2-small-res-jb. Against 83 hand-authored concepts spanning unrelated semantic domains, they recover 7 correlational matches, of which 1, or 14%, is causally inert. The sample is small, but the direction is consistent with the toy setting. They also report an unexpected atom-collision phenomenon: a small number of decoder atoms repeatedly appear as nearest matches for dozens of semantically unrelated concepts. This is replicated across three independently constructed concept batches of increasing size and diversity, and a controlled negative case argues against a prompt-template artifact.

Fifth, the reproducibility section explains why byte-exact reproducibility across platforms is unavailable for floating-point training workloads. The paper proposes a two-tier guarantee: SHA-256 byte exactness within one pinned environment, and semantic equality elsewhere with rtol = 1e-4 and boundary-sensitive integer counts allowed to vary by ±1.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is worth a careful read. Start with the central claim and keep it in mind throughout: decoder geometry and causal validity are different empirical statements. Once that is clear, the paper’s structure becomes straightforward.

On a first pass, read the Introduction and the contribution list to see that this is not just another toy SAE reproduction. Then jump directly to the causal validation section, especially the ablation and sign-correct steering protocol. Focus on how interventions are propagated to the model’s actual output layer and how inertness is operationally defined. That is the conceptual center of the paper.

Next, go back to the superposition phase-diagram reproduction. Pay attention to how the high-sparsity convergence artifact is diagnosed, how training budgets are adjusted with sparsity, and what characterizes the diffuse sharing regime. This helps explain why geometrically recovered features can still fail at the encoder or competition stage.

Then read the TopK-vs-L1 reproduction and the activation-refinement test. The key question there is not simply which SAE reconstructs better, but which one recovers features that remain causally actionable. If you usually look only at reconstruction, sparsity, or cosine metrics, this section fills in the missing encoder side.

After that, read the taxonomy and tooling sections. Structural vs competitive inertness and read- vs write-inertness are useful concepts because they turn intervention failure into something diagnosable. Finish with the real-model audit on gpt2-small-res-jb and the atom-collision finding to judge whether the toy conclusions already have echoes in practical SAEs.

If time is limited, prioritize Sections 6, 7, 10, and 11, then return to Sections 4 and 5. If you plan to reproduce the work, Section 8 on reproducibility conventions is also worth close attention.

recommendation.zh: 现有SAE评估的核心指标被证伪，做预训练表征分析或可解释性研究的必须看§4的因果实验设计，停止仅依赖余弦相似度判断特征恢复质量。
